111 template <class Message>
112 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, Error> send(const Message &message,
113 const std::string &queueName) {
114 auto sendStatus = messenger.send<Message>({queueName}, message);
115
116 if (!sendStatus.ok()) {
117 return std::unexpected(Error{Error::Kind::MessagingFailed,
118 "Failed to send " + messageLabel(message) +
119 ": " + sendStatus.reason()});
120 }
121 return {};
122 }

141 template <class Message>
142 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::optional<Message>, Error>
143 receive(const std::string &queueName, std::chrono::milliseconds timeout,
144 const std::atomic<bool> &terminationFlag) {
145 const bool waitIndefinitely = (timeout == WaitForever);
146 const auto pollInterval =
147 waitIndefinitely ? DefaultReceiveTimeout : timeout;
148
149 // The flag is the loop condition rather than a second conjunct alongside
150 // the timeout, so it is honoured at every timeout instead of only at 0.
151 while (!terminationFlag.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
152 // Manual ack keeps the broker-side no_ack flag false, so RabbitMQ's
153 // per-consumer prefetch actually throttles delivery instead of pushing
154 // every queued message onto this call's short-lived connection at once.
155 // The message is acked right after a successful decode.
156 auto received = messenger.receiveExtended<Message>(
157 {queueName}, mqss::ReceiveArgs{
158 .timeout = pollInterval,
159 .ack_mode = mqss::AckMode::Manual,
160 });
161 if (received.has_value()) {
162 auto &[message, delivery] = *received;
163 if (auto ackStatus = delivery.ack(); !ackStatus.ok()) {
164 spdlog::warn("Failed to ack {}: {}", messageLabel(message),
165 ackStatus.reason());
166 }
167 return std::optional<Message>(std::move(message));
168 }
169 if (received.error().code() != mqss::StatusCode::Timeout) {
170 return std::unexpected(
171 Error{Error::Kind::MessagingFailed,
172 "Receive error: " + received.error().reason()});
173 }
174 if (!waitIndefinitely) {
175 break;
176 }
177 }
178 return std::optional<Message>{};
179 }

196 template <class Message>
197 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::optional<Message>, Error>
198 receive(const std::string &queueName,
199 std::chrono::milliseconds timeout = DefaultReceiveTimeout) {
200 static const std::atomic<bool> NeverTerminates{false};
201 return receive<Message>(queueName, timeout, NeverTerminates);
202 }
203
204private:
205 mqss::Messenger<mqss::RabbitMqSimple, mqss::ProtoJson> messenger;
206};
